passages.text: Q3 2026 US revenue was USD 4.6 million, up 12% year over year. The KS-400 accounted for 58% of revenue.
The Q3 gross margin for US sales was 38.5%, down from 41% in Q2 because of higher freight costs.
Tamberline Supply contributed 35% of Q3 US revenue. The renewal rate for our top accounts was 92%.
